 Having already won the series opener in Auckland on Wednesday by five wickets, the tourists moved into a comfortable 2-0 lead on Saturday in Wellington thanks to a strong showing by India’s pace attack. The weather also played its part in a match reduced to 47 overs each, with Shubman Gill’s team earning a four-run win. 
 The Black Caps’ hopes of bouncing back could be thwarted by the weather, however, with the third ODI set to be another rain-interrupted affair at Seddon Park. 
 More from CNET
 The third ODI between New Zealand and India takes place on Tuesday , Nov. 10 , at Seddon Park in Hamilton. Play starts at 3 p.m. NZDT in New Zealand, which makes it a 7:30 a.m. IST start in India. For viewers in the US and Canada, it’s a 9 p.m. ET or 6 p.m. PT start on Monday evening, while play gets underway for those watching in the UK at 2 a.m. GMT early on Tuesday morning. For viewers in Australia, it’s a 1 p.m. AEDT start on Tuesday.
 How to watch New Zealand vs. India online from anywhere using a VPN
 If you’re traveling abroad and want to keep up with all the EPL action while away from home, a VPN can help enhance your privacy and security when streaming. 
 VPNs encrypt your traffic and prevent your internet service provider from throttling your speeds, and can also be helpful when connecting to public Wi-Fi networks while traveling, adding an extra layer of protection for your devices and logins. VPNs are legal in many countries, including the US and Canada, and can be used for legitimate purposes such as improving online privacy and security. 
 However, some streaming services may have policies that restrict VPN use for accessing region-specific content. If you’re considering a VPN for streaming, check the platform’s terms of service to ensure compliance. 
 If you choose to use a VPN, follow the provider’s installation instructions to ensure you’re connected securely and in compliance with applicable laws and service agreements. Some streaming platforms may block access when a VPN is detected, so verifying if your streaming subscription allows VPN usage is crucial.
